meta.title: Build A Ring Farm Pets

sources.label: Sportskeeda - All Build a Ring Farm pets and their abilities (primary roster, abilities, baseline earnings boost, source per pet)
TechWiser - Build a Ring Farm Eggs and How to Get Them (egg-to-pet mapping and egg costs)
Pro Game Guides - Build A Ring Farm Pets Tier List (independent corroboration of roster, rarity, abilities)
TechWiser - Build a Ring Farm Pets (independent corroboration of rarity grouping and abilities)
Sportskeeda - Build a Ring Farm Dinosaur Egg guide (limited-pet sourcing cross-check)

notes: Rarity tiers in ascending order: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Secret, Prismatic, Divine, Exotic. This ordering is consistent across the primary source and corroborating guides.

earningsBoost is pinned to a single baseline (Level 1 / Regular size) from the Sportskeeda primary source for consistency. Boosts scale upward with pet size (Regular, Big, Giant) and pet level (max level 50). Card/page copy must frame these as a baseline that scales, not a fixed value. Where sources disagreed on the number (size/level scaling), the primary source value is used; never mixed mid-row.

source field records where the pet originates (which egg, bundle, or Robux/pack purchase). Several pets are limited or event pets (Carnival Egg, Dinosaur Egg, Twilight/Dragon/Disco/Gummy Kingdom/Pirate Puddle bundles, Kitsune/Carnival packs). The page must state origin only and must NOT claim current availability or include event dates; availability windows for these have passed and the page is evergreen.

Section field is collectionSection holding the rarity. A CATALOG_SECTION_OVERRIDES entry keyed on 'build-a-ring-farm-pets' with sectionOrder Common->Exotic is expected at the route/writing step; without it cards may group by the wrong field.

No item images are sourced yet (0/30). Pet icons are not exposed as clean reusable URLs in the text sources. The image pass owns sourcing pet icons (game thumbnails / community references) or shipping with placeholders.

All 30 pets are confidently source-backed by at least the primary source, with most corroborated by 2+ guides. No invented pets. Pets appearing in only one source (e.g. Popcorn Phoenix) are flagged in their row notes.
